What We Do
                    
Expertise Across Today's Risk and People Issues
                
                

                    

                        At Aon, we’ve been on a decade-plus journey to connect our global capabilities so we can address our clients’ top priorities more effectively. Through our global expertise across two key areas of need ― Risk Capital and Human Capital ― our clients are better advised within, and across, their risk and people strategies.

                    Capability Overview
                
            

                Risk Capital
            
            
                Making Better Risk Decisions
            
            

                

                    Businesses and communities face a rapidly evolving range of interconnected risks. Our Risk Capital advisors bring the breadth of our expertise, relationships and analytics to unlock capital, which we access across markets, geographies and a variety of financial instruments to help organizations grow.

                    Capability Overview
                
            

                Human Capital
            
            
                Making Better People Decisions
            
            

                

                    People are an organization's most valuable asset, largest cost, and also a major source of risk― therefore, getting your people strategy right can often be the difference between success or failure. Our Human Capital products and advisors help clients navigate today's most pressing people challenges to create a healthier, more engaged, and ultimately more productive workforce.

 Aon is in the Business of Better Decisions
